lastTask: Implement Track D2 elite phrase audition

projectState.summary: Track D2 is implemented on codex/byte-d2-elite-audition and ready for Claude review. The app can audition the current top elite phrase candidate by routing its validated PlayerPatternSource genome through the existing melodyPhrasing transport hook, then refreshing the lookahead. The debug API is window.prosody.auditionEliteCandidate({ branchId, candidateId? }), window.prosody.getAudition(), and window.prosody.clearCandidateAudition(). This is reversible/debug-driven and does not add a new audio path, model call, automatic evolution loop, or persistence schema change. Carry forward: score developed children before a true next selection, fix branch-scoped candidate ids before parallel populations, handle rare no-op operator fallback, and later share/recompute B2 operators server-side before trusting operator provenance.
